'''Systino''' was a criminal syndicate operating in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. In [[4009 BBY]], the syndicate discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]], a world rich in valuable natural resources that they planned to exploit.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
